items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I see George Dino's father was up there too.

ctx.x: Well, the society is it. I mean, that's why. The benevolent society. The benevolent society don't have as many members as they used to have because so many people get so much out of insurance. See, the benevolent society, they furnish your barrel and all that, but it's not that much in it. And some of the guys been in there so long and have the money involved and they won't get out, see. So that still makes the organization still going on. They'll still get their benevolent, but they have what the insurance don't…
Yeah, they have a lot of names up there. I see George Dino's father was up there too.
You see, when the fellows belonged to all these different societies, he had an extra lawyer for them because each society was formed as a band, and each society turned out with the band.
